description.en-US: Connect documents, messages, calendars, and tables.
description.zh-CN: 连接文档、消息、日历与多维表格。

setup.en-US: Install the managed integration and connect your account.
setup.zh-CN: 安装集成并连接自己的账号。

description.en-US: Send text and Markdown notifications to a configured DingTalk group robot.
description.zh-CN: 向配置的钉钉群机器人发送文本或 Markdown 通知。

setup.en-US: Create a signed custom group robot. Enter its access_token and signing secret. This does not read chats, documents or calendars.
setup.zh-CN: 创建启用加签的自定义群机器人，填写 Webhook 的 access_token 和加签密钥。此插件不读取聊天、文档或日历。

description.en-US: Send text and Markdown notifications to a configured WeCom group robot.
description.zh-CN: 向配置的企业微信群机器人发送文本或 Markdown 通知。

setup.en-US: Create a group robot and copy the key parameter from its webhook URL. This does not connect the incoming chat channel or access documents.
setup.zh-CN: 创建群机器人，复制 Webhook 地址中的 key 参数。此插件用于主动通知，不接入收消息通道或读取文档。

description.en-US: Find and update shared documents and spreadsheets.
description.zh-CN: 查找与更新在线文档、表格，协同整理团队资料。

setup.en-US: Follow the provider's setup guide, prepare the required account or API credentials, then add its MCP server using Add MCP plugin. Adding a configuration does not verify the connection.
setup.zh-CN: 按提供方文档准备账号或 API 凭据，再通过「添加 MCP 插件」录入服务配置。保存配置后仍需验证连接和权限。
